tickets.title: Third Avenue L stop closure pilot request
tickets.summary: A public speaker who rides the L train said the Third Avenue stop has few boarding riders during rush hour, and his simulation of 700 million MTA trips suggested closing it would save New Yorkers time. He asked the board to refer the idea to the transportation committee. Action: Refer the Third Avenue stop closure idea to the transportation committee and ask the MTA about piloting a closure.

tickets.title: 11th Street e-bike storage and sidewalk obstruction
tickets.summary: Over 100 e-bikes used by food delivery workers are stored on the sidewalk and street at 11th Street, obstructing residents and businesses and creating fire-safety concerns. Speakers said the block lacks legal parking and corral space, and the precinct plans an enforcement action on October 7 that could confiscate bikes. Workers with limited English and French are struggling with the enforcement, and organizations asked for tagging instead of confiscation for two weeks. Action: Work with the precinct, sanitation, and worker groups on notice, translated outreach, legal parking or corral sites, and sanitation service on the block before and after the October 7 enforcement.
